exit_state: Cash awards remeasure through settlement; employee choice, entity choice and statutory withholding have distinct classification rules. Beneficial modifications preserve original service cost and add their own measured service period. Participation changes ordinary earnings as assumed shares change; the capped family has a restricted additive-gross-effect ordering derivation. Dependent EPS instead recalculates a shared bonus/tax function: two isolated addbacks12 would overstate joint earnings92 as96. At initial profit80, individual conversions raise EPS while the joint world lowers it; this does not authorize ignoring separate-series dilution. Official additive examples do not resolve the general selector. Paragraph57 conditional options require both a satisfied period-end condition and the similar outstanding series prerequisite.
